title: Claude secret codes most users don't know! #claude #AITools
description:
Claude is framed around five prompt codes that change how the AI responds, from more human-sounding answers to live app generation, strategic problem-solving, expert-level analysis, and a more aggressive response style. The script highlights /ghost, artifacts, OODA, L99, and /god mode as shortcuts for getting different kinds of output from Anthropic’s assistant.

The broader idea is prompt engineering as a practical productivity layer for AI users, especially builders, founders, and operators who want more control over output quality. Instead of changing models, these techniques position formatting and command structure as the lever for better execution inside the same chat environment.

For viewers, the value is speed: faster prototyping with artifacts, more structured decision-making with OODA, and more specialized or comprehensive answers with L99 and /god mode. It reflects the growing market trend of power-user workflows built on top of mainstream AI tools like Claude.
